name: morris-peoplesoft-utilities
description: Morris PeopleSoft Utilities — PeopleSoft Classic and Fluid productivity for Chrome and Firefox

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run audit:browsers
scripts.audit: npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:store && npm run audit:firefox && npm run audit:browsers && npm run audit:compliance
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run audit:store && npm run audit:firefox && tsx scripts/package-zip.ts chrome && tsx scripts/package-zip.ts firefox
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run package && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:compliance && npm run package:agents
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test && playwright test --config playwright.firefox.config.ts
scripts.build:chrome: npm run check:agents && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:firefox: npm run check:agents && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode firefox
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: npm run build:firefox && playwright test --config playwright.firefox.config.ts

author: hackmods (Ryan Morris)
